masks.name: Commander
masks.drive: Lead and direct others toward goals
masks.growthStrategy: Practice active listening and collaborative decision-making

masks.name: Champion
masks.drive: Achieve excellence and inspire others to win
masks.growthStrategy: Celebrate process over outcomes, practice rest

masks.name: Strategist
masks.drive: Plan and execute long-term visions
masks.growthStrategy: Practice rapid prototyping and iteration

masks.name: Challenger
masks.drive: Question norms and push boundaries
masks.growthStrategy: Build coalitions, choose battles wisely

masks.name: Guardian
masks.drive: Protect what matters and stand firm
masks.growthStrategy: Embrace calculated risk and allow others to face challenges

masks.name: Warlord
masks.drive: Dominate challenges through sheer force of will
masks.growthStrategy: Learn diplomacy and value long-term alliances

masks.name: Diplomat
masks.drive: Influence outcomes through negotiation and alliances
masks.growthStrategy: Be transparent about motives and take clear positions

masks.name: Enforcer
masks.drive: Uphold standards and ensure accountability
masks.growthStrategy: Balance justice with mercy, allow context to shape decisions

masks.name: Caregiver
masks.drive: Nurture and support others
masks.stressBehavior: Takes on others' problems, becomes overwhelmed
masks.growthStrategy: Practice self-care and healthy boundaries

masks.name: Mentor
masks.drive: Guide others toward their potential
masks.growthStrategy: Trust others' journeys, let go of outcomes

masks.name: Peacemaker
masks.drive: Create harmony and resolve conflict
masks.stressBehavior: Withdraws or appeases to avoid tension
masks.growthStrategy: Practice assertiveness and healthy disagreement

masks.name: Altruist
masks.drive: Serve a greater cause beyond self
masks.growthStrategy: Balance service with self-care and sustainability

masks.name: Empath
masks.drive: Feel deeply and understand others' inner worlds
masks.stressBehavior: Becomes emotionally flooded, withdraws to recover
masks.growthStrategy: Build emotional shielding practices and set clear boundaries

masks.name: Healer
masks.drive: Restore and mend what is broken
masks.stressBehavior: Focuses on healing others while ignoring own needs
masks.growthStrategy: Heal yourself first, accept that not everything can be fixed

masks.name: Connector
masks.drive: Build bridges between people and communities
masks.stressBehavior: Over-socializes or retreats from all connections
masks.growthStrategy: Deepen key relationships rather than expanding the network

masks.name: Devotee
masks.drive: Commit fully and love unconditionally
masks.growthStrategy: Practice detachment with love and embrace change as growth

masks.name: Sage
masks.drive: Seek wisdom and understanding
masks.growthStrategy: Apply knowledge through action, engage with present

masks.name: Analyst
masks.drive: Understand through data and logic
masks.growthStrategy: Trust intuition, embrace uncertainty

masks.name: Architect
masks.drive: Design elegant systems and structures
masks.growthStrategy: Ship imperfect versions, iterate in public

masks.name: Inventor
masks.drive: Create novel solutions and possibilities
masks.stressBehavior: Jumps to new ideas, abandons projects
masks.growthStrategy: Finish what you start, build execution habits

masks.name: Scholar
masks.drive: Master a domain through deep study
masks.stressBehavior: Retreats into study, avoids real-world engagement
masks.growthStrategy: Apply knowledge to solve real problems, teach others

masks.name: Detective
masks.drive: Uncover hidden truths and solve mysteries
masks.growthStrategy: Balance skepticism with trust, know when to stop digging

masks.name: Philosopher
masks.drive: Question existence and seek deeper meaning
masks.stressBehavior: Falls into existential doubt, questions everything
masks.growthStrategy: Ground philosophy in daily practice and meaningful action

masks.name: Engineer
masks.drive: Build practical solutions that work reliably
masks.stressBehavior: Over-engineers solutions, refuses to ship imperfect work
masks.growthStrategy: Embrace creative experimentation and tolerate imperfection

masks.name: Explorer
masks.drive: Discover the unknown and expand horizons
masks.stressBehavior: Escapes into new adventures, avoids problems
masks.growthStrategy: Build roots while exploring, honor commitments

masks.name: Creator
masks.drive: Express and bring vision into reality
masks.growthStrategy: Embrace constraints as creative fuel, seek feedback

masks.name: Rebel
masks.drive: Challenge status quo and forge new paths
masks.growthStrategy: Pick meaningful battles, build alliances

masks.name: Visionary
masks.drive: See and communicate transformative possibilities
masks.stressBehavior: Escapes into fantasy, avoids present reality
masks.growthStrategy: Ground visions in actionable steps, partner with executors

masks.name: Mystic
masks.drive: Connect with the unseen and transcend the ordinary
masks.stressBehavior: Retreats into inner world, disconnects from reality
masks.growthStrategy: Stay connected to community and engage with practical matters

masks.name: Dreamer
masks.drive: Imagine worlds that could be and inspire hope
masks.stressBehavior: Escapes into daydreams, procrastinates on action
masks.growthStrategy: Turn dreams into plans with concrete first steps

masks.name: Shaman
masks.drive: Bridge worlds and guide transformative experiences
masks.stressBehavior: Becomes eccentric or withdraws into ritual
masks.growthStrategy: Ground spiritual gifts in evidence and community accountability

masks.name: Pioneer
masks.drive: Blaze new trails into uncharted territory
masks.stressBehavior: Pushes further into the unknown, refuses to turn back
masks.growthStrategy: Build sustainable systems behind your frontier advances
